Adds portable document export for the current in-memory sheet on macOS, Linux amd64, and Raspberry Pi. The new Export menu creates editable Word documents, fixed-layout Letter PDFs, or reflowable EPUB 3 ebooks without changing the source Markdown.

All three formats use one shared CommonMark structure for titles, headings, paragraphs, emphasis, quotations, lists, code, and scene breaks. YAML front matter is omitted, a matching opening title is not duplicated, and destinations are written atomically. PDF embeds open Source Serif 4 fonts for portable Unicode text; EPUB includes metadata, navigation, XHTML, and local CSS.

Folder/project assembly, title-page options, Markdown tables, and image embedding remain planned follow-up work. Editing, autosave, History, universal sync, Inbox, and Trash behavior are unchanged.

Signed desktop release for macOS Apple Silicon, Linux amd64, and Raspberry Pi ARM64.

This is a personal project under active development. Back up important writing and review the release notes before updating.
